choices.why: No green velvet sofa is offered, so the charcoal rolled-arm three-seater with black turned legs is the closest classic option and matches the dark mantel.
A pair of elegant cream wingback chairs on dark tapered legs frames the fireplace in a classic way and lightens the dark sofa.
This large traditional medallion rug in charcoal and cream is big enough for the whole seating group and ties the sofa to the cream chairs.
This dark espresso wood table with an X-base suits the classic look and fits well between sofa and fireplace.
This wide champagne-gold overlay mirror is about a metre across, so it suits the chimney breast and adds period elegance above the mantel.
This turned-column lamp with a linen drum shade has a traditional silhouette that matches the cream chairs and the historic room.

answer.why: The charcoal sofa, cream wingbacks and charcoal-and-cream medallion rug form a cohesive neutral palette that echoes the dark mantel and suits the pale mint walls and mouldings. Dark wood, gold and linen accents give the room a classic, elegant feel around the fireplace.
